# Availability is not access

An unlocked catalogue is still difficult to use if its categories are unfamiliar. Watched two visitors search for the old ferry name under different spellings. Neither was making an error. Add alternative names without silently replacing the words on the original records. [[Listening]] and [[Field methods]] need a way to preserve disagreement in the index.
